title: Propitiatory
summary: PROPI'TIATORY, adjective Having the power to make propitious; as a propitiatory sacrifice. PROPI'TIATORY, noun Among the Jews, the mercy-seat; the lid or cover of the ark of the covenant, lined within

inlines.v: PROPI'TIATORY, adjective Having the power to make propitious; as a propitiatory sacrifice. PROPI'TIATORY, noun Among the Jews, the mercy-seat; the lid or cover of the ark of the covenant, lined within and without with plates of gold. This was a type of Christ.
